notes.title: Big Winter Update

tags.feature: - 2 new maps that are great for playing 2-4 players;
- New shooting effects, sounds, bullet animations;
- 7 types of weapons
- New menu;
- New music in the menu;
- New lobby;
- Improved optimization;
- A flashlight has been added, but for now it is always on.

notes.title: Results for today

tags.feature: - Now the 1-person shooter, honestly, I really liked it, it looks clearly nicer;
- New weapons, remaking the sounds of old ones, bullet effects and more;
- 3 new maps: military base in the forest, desert and city;
- Zombies now use different animations, new sounds;
- Turrets with a minigun and a flamethrower, of course you can add a rocket launcher and a laser, but I didn't really like them;
- Optimization, now FPS is much more stable;
- Redesigned menu and lobby
